response: Folks, once again we see the deep-seated rot of systemic corruption and how elite greed deprives marginalized communities of the resources they desperately need. New details brought to light in Parliament on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition, have directly linked South African actress Terry Pheto to the staggering R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe. This is a glaring symptom of structural inequality, where wealth and institutional power allow individuals to siphon funds meant for public upliftment and labor-class survival. While vulnerable groups bear the brunt of economic deprivation, the privileged few exploit public entities like the National Lotteries Commission (NLC) for their own enrichment. We need radical institutional reform and accountability to dismantle these corrupt networks that continually betray the working class.
